errors.disabled: automations are not enabled on this install
errors.workspace_undetermined: cannot tell which workspace this automation belongs to
errors.enter_stage_failed: task created but could not enter stage {stage:%q}
errors.agent_cannot_answer: agent {agent:%q} has no prompt to answer mentions with (neither prompts/mention.md nor prompts/main.md); add one on the Agents page
errors.agent_no_mention_stage: agent {agent:%q} does not answer mentions: it does not declare the mention stage in thulu.stages
errors.mcp_not_wired: mcp server {server:%q} is not wired on this install (known: {known})
errors.mcp_http_unsupported: mcp server {server:%q} speaks Streamable HTTP; automation steps only reach SSE servers
errors.mcp_credential_unsupported: mcp server {server:%q} authenticates with a workspace credential; automation steps cannot use credentials yet
errors.no_sandbox_manager: no sandbox manager on this install
errors.env_metrics_disabled: environment metrics are not enabled on this install
errors.no_credential_store: no credential store on this install
errors.credential_no_token: credential {name:%q} has no single token field ({fields})
errors.credential_not_found: no credential named {name:%q} in this workspace
errors.stage_gated: task created but held before stage {stage:%q}: waiting for approval ({approvals})
errors.environment_not_found: no environment {environment:%q} in this workspace (environment takes the environment's ID, not its name)
errors.ref_templated: {field} does not take {{ }} templates: the run would look up {value:%q} as written; put an ID that exists
